[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
if substring.length = 0 then
  string.length
else
  let mut count := 0
  let mut i := 0
  while i ≤ string.length - substring.length {
    if string.drop i.take substring.length = substring then
      count := count + 1
    i := i + 1
  }
  count
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_drop_take_eq
(str: String)
(sub: String)
(i: Nat)
(h: i ≤ str.length - sub.length)
: (str.drop i).take sub.length = sub :=
by
simp [str.drop, str.take]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string substring
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_sub_empty: substring.length = 0
-- if substring.length = 0 then
simp [h_sub_empty]
have h_sub_empty_result: result = string.length := by
  simp [h_sub_empty]
simp [h_sub_empty_result]
exact And.intro h_sub_empty_result
-- if substring.length ≠ 0 then
have h_sub_non_empty: substring.length ≠ 0 := by
  linarith
by_cases h_str_empty: string.length = 0
-- if string.length = 0 then
simp [h_str_empty]
have h_str_empty_result: result = 0 := by
  simp [h_str_empty]
simp [h_str_empty_result]
exact And.intro h_str_empty_result
-- if string.length < substring.length then
have h_str_lt_sub: string.length < substring.length := by
  linarith
have h_str_lt_sub_result: result = 0 := by
  simp [h_str_lt_sub]
simp [h_str_lt_sub_result]
exact And.intro h_str_lt_sub_result
-- if string.length = substring.length then
have h_str_eq_sub: string.length = substring.length := by
  linarith
have h_str_eq_sub_result: result = 1 ↔ string = substring := by
  simp [h_str_eq_sub]
have h_str_eq_sub_result': string = substring → result = 1 := by
  simp [h_str_eq_sub, h_str_eq_sub_result]
have h_str_eq_sub_result'' : string ≠ substring → result = 0 := by
  simp [h_str_eq_sub, h_str_eq_sub_result]
exact And.intro h_str_eq_sub_result' h_str_eq_sub_result''
-- if substring.length < string.length then
have h_sub_lt_str: substring.length < string.length := by
  linarith
have h_sub_lt_str_result: result = (string.drop i).take substring.length = substring.card |>.toFinset.card := by
  simp [h_sub_lt_str]
have h_sub_lt_str_result': i := 0
  simp [h_sub_lt_str_result']
  have h_i_le_str_len_sub_len: i ≤ string.length - substring.length := by
    simp [h_sub_lt_str]
  have h_i_le_str_len_sub_len': i = 0 := by
    simp [h_i_le_str_len_sub_len]
  simp [h_i_le_str_len_sub_len']
  have h_str_drop_i_take_sub_eq_sub: (string.drop i).take substring.length = substring := by
    apply string_drop_take_eq
    simp [h_i_le_str_len_sub_len']
  simp [h_str_drop_i_take_sub_eq_sub]
  have h_i_eq_str_len_sub_len: i = string.length - substring.length := by
    simp [h_sub_lt_str]
  simp [h_i_eq_str_len_sub_len]
  have h_finset_card: (string.drop i).take substring.length = substring.card |>.toFinset.card := by
    simp [h_str_drop_i_take_sub_eq_sub]
  simp [h_finset_card]
simp [h_sub_lt_str_result']
exact And.intro h_sub_lt_str_result'
[END]
